title: Spicy Bell Pepper & Scrambled Egg Wrap with Mango-Spinach Salad

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince shallot and garlic; place both in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the shallot and garlic, then add oil and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel mangos and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; medium dice and add to the bowl with the dressing. Set aside.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add bell pepper and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, crack eggs into another medium bowl and whisk until smooth.

When the bell pepper is done, pour the eggs into the skillet. Scramble the eggs using a combination of stirring and folding, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny; remove from heat.
While the eggs are cooking, add spinach to the bowl with the dressing and mango; toss to combine the salad.
Place tortillas on a flat surface and divide scrambled eggs between them; roll tightly to close.
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
